notes_for_editor: Thin: no NRHP-style nomination, no newspapers searched, no wrecks found. Keepers table name and date (Jos. J. D. Gallant, 21 Oct 1902, $285) in the 1910 report matched by OCR adjacency; the 1902 report's table was dropped because it gives only the date and its name column is separated. Federal heritage 1991 comes from our record; the Parks Canada page returned no text. Lighthouse Friends gives 12.4 m height and 1884 salary $200 (not used as height); record says 13.0 m. Edward J. Arsenault later built the Bottle Houses nearby (Lighthouse Friends) - not used in story.
